title: Devendra v. Superintendent Engineer
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amitava Lala, J. and Sanjay Misra, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; relegated to CGRF and Ombudsman under clause 7.10.
headnote: A writ is not entertained where the Executive Engineer has already considered the consumer's grievance; the alternative forum is the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum and the Ombudsman under clause 7.10 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Dismissal does not prejudice the right to approach that forum, which must carefully consider any civil court decree and the fact of possession.
facts: Devendra approached the Allahabad High Court by Writ-C No. 28106 of 2011 against the Superintending Engineer and another. His electricity-supply grievance had already been considered by the Executive Engineer. The underlying controversy involved a civil court decree and the petitioner's possession of the premises. He sought writ interference rather than proceeding before the statutory consumer forum. The Division Bench heard the petition on 17 May 2011.

holding_units.holding: Where the Executive Engineer has already considered the consumer's grievance, the High Court will not interfere in writ; the alternative forum is the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum and the Ombudsman under clause 7.10 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The dismissal does not affect the right to approach that forum for early disposal, and the forum must carefully go into any civil court decree and the petitioner's possession.

not_decided.point: Merits of the electricity grievance, including the civil court decree and possession
not_decided.note: Left to the CGRF/Ombudsman; the writ court declined to decide.
